      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),

## Accomplished

- GO term enrichment analysis on high-expression & high-accessibility gene sets (clusterProfiler).
- Variability in accessibility across TFs (chromVAR).
- Construct TF network (TOBIAS).
- Rank top TFs per cluster with similar method as Tang _et al._

## Genes of interest

```{r gene_quadrants, out.width='80%'}
diff_dat <- read_tsv(params$atac_rna_tsv) %>% 
    mutate(cluster_id = as.factor(cluster_id))

alpha_level <- 0.05
log2fc_thresh <- 0

diff_dat_filt <- diff_dat %>% 
  filter(pvalue_rna < alpha_level, pvalue_atac < alpha_level, 
         abs(log2FoldChange_atac) >= log2fc_thresh, abs(log2FoldChange_rna) >= log2fc_thresh)

diff_dat_filt_cat <- diff_dat_filt %>% 
    mutate(category = case_when(
        log2FoldChange_rna > 0 & log2FoldChange_atac > 0 ~ 'HE-HA',
        log2FoldChange_rna > 0 & log2FoldChange_atac < 0 ~ 'HE-LA',
        log2FoldChange_rna < 0 & log2FoldChange_atac > 0 ~ 'LE-HA',
        log2FoldChange_rna < 0 & log2FoldChange_atac < 0 ~ 'LE-LA',
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

min_max <- list(min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
abs_max <- diff_dat_filt_cat %>%
        summarize(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), min_max)) %>%
        as.list() %>% unname() %>% unlist() %>% abs() %>% max()
p <- diff_dat_filt_cat %>%
        mutate(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
        ggplot(
            aes(
                y = log2FoldChange_atac,
                x = log2FoldChange_rna,
                color = category,
                group = category,
                text = glue(
                    'gene name:\t{gene_name}',
                    'cluster:\t{cluster_id}',
                    'ATAC log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_atac}',
                    'RNA log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_rna}',
                    .sep = '\n'
                )
            )
        ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_vline(
            xintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_color_viridis_d() +
        guides(color = guide_legend(title = '')) +
        lims(x = c(-abs_max, abs_max),
             y = c(-abs_max, abs_max)) +
        labs(y = 'ATAC log2(FC)', x = 'RNA log2(FC)')

ggplotly(p, tooltip = 'text')
```

- HE-HA: High Expression (RNAseq) and High Accessibility (ATACseq)
- LE-LA: Low Expression (RNAseq) and Low Accessibility (ATACseq)

## Top enriched GO terms in HE-HA gene sets

```{r clusterProfiler, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
load(params$clusterprofiler_rdata)

n_top <- 10
enrich_plot <- enrich_results %>%
  mutate(ID = str_replace_all(ID, "_", " ") %>% str_wrap(width = 80)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = gene_ratio, n = n_top) %>%
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(ID, .x = Count)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(gene_ratio, name, size = Count, #color = cluster_id,
             text = glue("Gene Ratio: {GeneRatio}\n{name}"))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster_id, scales = 'free', nrow = 3
             ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    #title = glue("Top {n_top} enriched GO terms in HE-HA genes"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
  )
enrich_plot
ggplotly(enrich_plot, tooltip = 'text')
```

::: {.notes}
- Gene Ratio: genes of interest that match the GO term / total genes of interest
- Count: genes of interest that match the GO term (i.e. numerator of Gene Ratio)

y axis order is by Count
:::

## chromVAR - variability in accessibility across all TFs

```{r chromvar}
load(params$chromvar_rdata)

var_plot <- chromVAR::plotVariability(variability, use_plotly = FALSE)
print(var_plot)
```

## chromVAR top TFs

```{r chromvar_top_tfs}
plot_top_var_tfs <- function(var_df, n_top = 20, 
                             title_str = glue::glue("Top {n_top} TFs by variability in accessibility")) {
    top_tfs <- var_df %>%
      slice_max(order_by = variability, n = n_top) %>%
      arrange(desc(variability)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      arrange(variability)
    var_plot_top <- top_tfs %>%
      mutate(tf = factor(name, levels = top_tfs %>% pull(name))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(
        y = tf,
        x = variability,
        xmin = bootstrap_lower_bound,
        xmax = bootstrap_upper_bound
      )) +
      geom_pointrange() +
      labs(
        y = "",
        title = title_str
      ) +
      theme_bw()
    return(var_plot_top)
}
plot_top_var_tfs(variability)
```

## chromVAR on clusters separately

```{r chromvar_clusters}
# rm(list = Filter(function(x) {
#     str_detect(x, 'sovacool', negate = TRUE) &
#         str_detect(x, 'params', negate = TRUE)
# }, ls()))
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c1.RData")
variability_c1 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c2.RData")
variability_c2 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c3.RData")
variability_c3 <- variability

var_df <- bind_rows(
    variability_c1 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c1'),
    variability_c2 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c2'),
    variability_c3 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c3')
)
var_plots <- c('c1','c2','c3') %>%
    map(\(x) var_df %>% filter(cluster_id == x) %>% plot_top_var_tfs(title = glue("{x} Top TFs")))
var_plots[[1]] + var_plots[[2]] + var_plots[[3]]
```

## Key TFs per cluster


```{r key TFs}
plot_heatmap_row <- function(dat, value_column = A_diff,
                             scale_fill = scale_fill_viridis_c) {
  dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = gene_name, y = 1, # y = diff,
      fill = {{ value_column }}
    )) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_wrap(~cluster_id, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      y = quo_name(enquo(value_column)),
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    )
}
top_tfs <- read_csv(params$top_tfs)

# plot TFs patchwork
(plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, outdegree) +
  colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Blue-Red',
                                              limits = c(-10.5,10.5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, expression) +
    colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Green-Orange',
                                                limits = c(-7.31,7.31)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank()
    )
  ) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, accessibility) +
       colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Purple-Green',
                                                   limits = c(-20,20))  +
    theme(strip.text = element_blank()))

```
